contract_answer.question: Does replacing Relative Huber with standardized-target MSE change the three-split MAPE by at least 0.008 on the frozen NA-E009 recipe?
contract_answer.conclusion: Direct recomputation of all 600 selected-checkpoint predictions gives split-2024 MAPE 0.125594, Acc@15 0.680000, RMSE 26.8680 cycles, and bias +6.3756 cycles, versus NA-E011 at 0.109135, 0.743333, 24.3097, and +0.5139. Across NA-E029/030/031, MSE is 0.106198 +/- 0.029159 MAPE versus Relative Huber 0.108654 +/- 0.008549: the -0.002456 difference is inside the registered +/-0.008 band, so the family result is TIED. The existing split-level decision is DISCARD.

main_symptom: On split 2024 MSE raises MAPE by 0.01646, lowers Acc@15 by 0.06333, and raises RMSE by 2.56 cycles; the family mean remains tied only because split 2021 moves strongly in the opposite direction.

causes.class: evaluation variance: the six-cell splits disagree sharply on the MSE effect
supporting_evidence: validation_predictions.npz::cell_id has 6 unique cells and 600 prefix samples
MSE split MAPEs are 0.072665/0.120335/0.125594 versus Relative Huber 0.099874/0.116952/0.109135
MSE MAPE sample std is 0.029159 versus 0.008549 for Relative Huber
contradicting_evidence: MSE is substantially better on split 2021
All predictions and training diagnostics are finite
causes.interpretation: The 2024 regression is meaningful by the 0.008 threshold, but the family-level conclusion must use all splits; their disagreement makes the aggregate TIED and exposes increased variance.

causes.class: objective tradeoff: MSE increases positive bias and worsens early/middle prefixes
supporting_evidence: NA-E011 parent bands are 0.1539/0.1348/0.1375/0.0867/0.0737, so every prefix band worsens
Bias rises from +0.5139 to +6.3756 cycles and prediction/target spread rises from 1.1110 to 1.1683
contradicting_evidence: The late 76-100 band remains better than the early bands
The model preserves strong prediction-target correlation of 0.8334
causes.interpretation: Squared-error weighting overshoots this split and degrades every observation horizon, consistent with the worse MAPE, Acc@15, and RMSE rather than an isolated band effect.
missing_evidence: A larger Na-ion validation cohort would be needed to estimate loss-by-cell interactions precisely
